contests.title: Lake Park — Measure GX: Emergency services facility borrowing

provenance.sourceOrg: Dickinson County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the City of Lake Park, State of Iowa, 
issue its General Obligation Bonds or 
Capital Loan Notes in an amount not 
exceeding the amount of $4,600,000 for the 
purpose of paying costs of designing, 
constructing, equipping, and furnishing a 
new Emergency Services Facility, with 
related site improvements and acquisition of 
real estate therefor?

contests.title: Spirit Lake Community School District — Measure GW: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Dickinson County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the Spirit 
Lake Community School District in the 
County of Dickinson, State of Iowa, be 
authorized to contract indebtedness and 
issue General Obligation Bonds in an 
amount not to exceed $69,990,000 to 
provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, 
and equip existing school buildings, 
including academic, common, and 
extracurricular spaces at the high school, 
middle school, and elementary school; to 
build, furnish, and equip additions to the 
high school, middle school, and elementary 
school; to build a new bus barn; and to 
improve the sites, including improvements 
to existing athletic facilities and the 
elementary playground?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $69.99 million in general-obligation bonds for renovations and additions at the elementary, middle and high schools, including academic, common and extracurricular spaces; a new bus barn; and site improvements, including athletic facilities and the elementary playground.
